items.description: Installation of the new glass into the frame
items.rationale: Excluded by 3.5 and 2.7.3: all glazing work, including installation, is not covered unless the optional glazing peril is agreed. Reference Case 3 confirms t = 0 for this line.
Excluded by 3.5 and 2.7.3: disposal of glazing elements is not covered unless the optional glazing peril is agreed. Reference Case 3 confirms t = 0 for this line.

items.description: Repair of dented solid-wood side table (knocked over in the same fall)
items.rationale: Covered under 2.6 (sudden accidental damage) and 7.1.1(b): the side table is movable property, damaged by a covered peril. Reference Case 3 (cabinet timber repair) suggests t >= 329 for similar work; side table repair is likely similar or slightly less, so estimate at 300 EUR gross.

items.description: Touch-up of pre-existing scratches on a second cabinet (present before the incident)
items.rationale: Excluded by 3.6(a) and 7.1.9: pre-existing conditions are not covered, even if treated at the same time as covered work. Reference Case 2 confirms t = 0 for similar lines.

Indemnified only if associated with covered work (7.1.12). Since the side table repair is covered, one attendance is payable. Reference Case 3 and 2 show vehicle costs are often declined, but if paid, t < 28. Estimate at 20 EUR gross.

Excluded by 7.1.12: only one attendance per undertaking per insured event is indemnified unless the insurer agreed to a return visit in advance, which is not stated. Reference Case 3 confirms t = 0 for additional attendances.
Excluded by 7.1.8(b): general administrative, handling, or processing charges are not indemnified, even if levied as a flat rate. Reference Case 4 confirms t = 0 for similar lines.
